## What changes for users?

Describe the knowledge gap, confusing behavior, or installation/release issue this change addresses.

## Guidance and sources

Link affected guides and authoritative sources. Explain relevant version differences, assumptions, and any adapted upstream material with its revision/license.

## Checks and evidence

Describe the checks actually performed and their results. Distinguish documentation review from model observations and live operations. Keep credentials, customer identifiers, and private output out of this pull request.

- [ ] Updated canonical guidance and catalog/routing when relevant.
- [ ] Review dates reflect actual source/content review.
- [ ] Preserved existing identities/reference paths or explained compatibility implications.
- [ ] Ran the applicable lightweight checks and updated the changelog.
